= source-callouts(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-08-30
:mansource: acdc
:manmanual: Source callout checks

== NAME

source-callouts - verify source callout presentation

== SYNOPSIS

source-callouts

== DESCRIPTION

=== Explicit C-style guard

[source,rust]
----
let value = 1; // <1>
----
<1> Defines the value.

=== Automatic hash guards

[source,python]
----
print("one") # <.>
print("two") # <.>
----
<.> Prints one.
<.> Prints two.

=== SQL guard

[source,sql]
----
SELECT 1; -- <1>
----
<1> Selects one.

=== XML callout

[source,xml]
----
<value>one</value> <!--1-->
----
<1> Describes the element.

=== Styled source paragraph

[source,ruby]
puts "paragraph" # <1>

<1> Prints from a source paragraph.
